roleHelp.owner: Runs the business on EventDesk: listings, team and settings. There is one owner.
roleHelp.admin: Works on listings and invites staff. Cannot appoint or remove other admins.
roleHelp.staff: Works on listings. Does not change the team or the settings.

choose.title: Choose the business
choose.description: You are on more than one team.

start.title: List your business
start.description: Listing is free. You say what you do and where, a moderator checks it, then the business appears in the directory — in the same daily rotation as everyone else.
start.step1: You create the business account. It takes a minute.
start.step2: You add up to five listings: categories and localities chosen from lists, a description, contact details, photos.
start.step3: A moderator unconnected to the business checks every listing and every change. What is already public stays unchanged meanwhile.
start.emailRequiredBody: A business account needs an email address: moderators' decisions and, later, clients' enquiries arrive there.

fields.name: Business name
fields.nameHint: As it is known. Each listing has its own public name.
fields.onrcHint: In the form J12/345/2020. You can add it later; a moderator can verify it, free of charge.
fields.onrcChangeHint: If you change it, the ONRC check starts again for the new number.

restriction.restrictedBody: The listings stay public, but you cannot add or change anything until the restriction is lifted.
restriction.suspendedBody: The listings no longer appear in the directory until the suspension is lifted.
restriction.contact: If you disagree with the decision, reply to the email you received from EventDesk.

lapsed.title: You cannot add new listings right now
lapsed.body: Your existing listings stay live and you can correct them at any time.

kinds.business_restored: The restriction on the business has been lifted
kinds.revision_approved: A listing has been approved and is public

team.alone: You are the only one on the team. You can invite colleagues below.
team.emailHint: We send a link valid for 14 days. It works for this address only.
team.inviteNeedsFresh: Confirm it is you first, then you can send invitations.
team.freshBody: Changes to the team need a recent confirmation.

settings.nudge: Reminder after 48 hours for unanswered enquiries
settings.nudgeHint: The notice when an enquiry arrives always comes; only the reminder can be turned off.
settings.hideStats: Hide response statistics on all listings
settings.hideStatsHint: The statistics appear only after ten enquiries you have answered. You can hide them at any time.

badges.title: Verified facts
badges.body: Only two statements can appear on listings, both plain facts: the ONRC registration and the insurance a moderator has seen, with the date it is valid until.
badges.none: No fact has been verified yet.
badges.how: The checks are done by a moderator and are free. For ONRC, fill in the registration number above.

invite.title: Team invitation
invite.body: You have been invited to the “{business}” team as {role}.
invite.goneTitle: The invitation is no longer valid
invite.goneBody: It has already been used or withdrawn.
invite.expiredBody: Ask an admin of “{business}” to send it again.

email.inviteSubject: Invitation to the {business} team on EventDesk
email.inviteIntro: You have been invited to the “{business}” team on EventDesk, as {role}.
email.inviteValidity: The link is valid for {days} days and works for this email address only.
email.inviteNotExpected: If you were not expecting this message, you can ignore it.

status.active: The restriction on {business} has been lifted

revision.approved: A listing of {business} has been approved
revision.rejected: A listing of {business} was not approved

listing.suspended: A listing of {business} has been suspended
listing.restored: A listing of {business} is public again

errors.emailRequired: A business account needs an email address. Add one to your account first.
errors.alreadyOwner: You already have a business on this account.
errors.roleRequired: Your role in the business does not allow this.
errors.adminCannotManageAdmins: An admin cannot appoint or remove other admins. Only the owner can.
errors.ownerStays: The owner cannot be removed from the team.
errors.alreadyMember: This address is already on the team.
errors.inviteGone: The invitation is no longer valid.
errors.inviteExpired: The invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.inviteOtherEmail: The invitation was sent to another email address. Sign in with the address that received it.
errors.restricted: The business is restricted: you cannot add or change anything until the restriction is lifted.
errors.suspended: The business is suspended: you cannot add or change anything until the suspension is lifted.
errors.lapsed: You cannot add new listings right now. Existing listings stay live and can be corrected.
